dict.string: Ember schedules your wake alarm to match your rest plan, so your wake time stays anchored even after late nights or travel.
Ember reads your upcoming events so it can pre-adapt your rest plan around late nights, early meetings, and travel before they disrupt your sleep.

Ember reads your sleep, steps, active energy, and exercise time from Apple Health to personalize your rest plan and calculate Rest Journey points from your real activity.
Ember does not write to Apple Health.
Ember uses your location to personalize your daily rhythm, sunrise, sunset, and sleep recommendations. It also helps personalize sleep climate insights.
Ember uses the microphone so you can speak a mind dump and review it before sending.
Ember uses speech recognition to turn your spoken mind dump into editable text.
